data.title: bn-g2i: verifier edit and enforcement gate
data.description: Passive verifier admission checks the exact Teapot v1 edit and pass reports through the bounded adapter. Review whether argv can reach a target, incomplete or contradictory output can admit a run, required egress can be downgraded, observed instance or lock drift can pass, or sensitive native output can escape. Validation passed: full just check, frozen wrapper mutation and failure cases, and the SHA-256-pinned Teapot loopback refusal test. The startup test uses a Playpen capability probe stand-in and observed no launch or target traffic.

data.body: HIGH: The API cannot record the required end-of-run edit surface when edits become active. `observe` returns an error at the first active category, and `GateRefusal` retains only a reason and command exits; the already-read surface is discarded. For example, add a response rule after a successful start observation: the ending call reports ActiveRule but provides no rule/session/intercept/script observations for the run record. Even successful observations retain counts only, so two different same-sized surfaces are indistinguishable. Return a redacted, sufficiently descriptive observation independently of the admission decision (including partial/unavailable status), and test start/end recording when the end has mixed active/inactive edits. This is distinct from the documented unavoidable TOCTOU window.

MEDIUM: The zero-target-traffic witness is not positively controlled in this test: the fixture URL is never passed to preflight or any target-capable call, and the listener is never sent a request proving it counts traffic. Likewise the wrapper forbidden-file assertion is never exercised with a forbidden argv. The test proves the selected passive calls returned a refusal, but cannot establish that a coordinator attempting a run refuses before its send, nor that these witnesses would detect a regression. Add positive controls and an integration test that drives the actual admission/send ordering once the coordinator exists; until then qualify this as adapter-only evidence.

data.reason: End-of-run edit-surface evidence is discarded on refusal; the no-traffic witnesses also lack positive controls. See th-1w7qgl and th-4glvbr.

data.body: The gate now retains identity-checked edit readings on success and refusal. Each reading holds typed facts and a SHA-256 of the native result JSON; an unexpected credential-values payload yields neither. The focused tests distinguish same-count surfaces, preserve mixed active and inactive edits in an ending refusal, and retain earlier reports when a later read is malformed.

with_verifier_admission invokes its callback after successful preflight. The fixture matrices assert one callback on success and zero on refusal, and positively exercise the forbidden send, macro, and session-probe argv markers. The digest-pinned native harness exercises the same dispatcher after clean admission and on refusals: one real loopback GET on clean admission and zero additional sink requests on refusal. The Playpen launch marker also has a positive control. This covers the admission helper; the full run coordinator is future work.
